column4: Social Security Benefit Scheme for Media Personnel
(1) The date before which contributions are payable

column3: by  a  contributor  shall  be  specified  in  the  Benefit  Scheme
Policy and any contributor who fails to pay ten consecutive
instalments on or before such date shall forfeit the benefits
under the Benefit Scheme Policy issued to him.

column4: (2) Where any contributor has forfeited the benefits under

column3: the Benefits Scheme Policy issued to him, the Board shall
issue a notice to that effect to such contributor.

column4: (3) A contributor shall have right to appeal to the Board

column3: to  validate  his  Benefit  Scheme  Policy  and  the  Board  shall
validate such Policy if it is satisfied that the reasons for failure
to  pay  the  instalments  were  beyond  the  control  of  the
contributor.

column4: (4) Where  the  Board  on  appeal,  decides  to  validate  a

column3: Benefit Scheme Policy, the contributor shall be informed of
the date before which the arrears of instalments have to be
paid. The date of such payment shall be the operative date of
validation of such Policy.

column4: (5) Any  contributor  aggrieved  by  the  decision  of  the

column3: Board,  may  appeal  to  the  Secretary  to  the  Ministry  of  the
Minister in charge of the subject of Finance whose decision
thereon, shall be final and conclusive.

column4: No benefit payable under the Benefit Scheme shall

column3: be  assigned  or  transferred  and  every  such  assignment  or
transfer shall be absolutely null and void. No such benefit
shall  be  attached  or  taken  in  execution  on  account  of  any
debt or payment due from the person to whom such benefit is
payable.
